post.description: Redeem one invitation exactly once and issue an unrestricted session.

Rotate the live session to one previously proven passenger identity.

The caller supplies only a group identifier. The identity itself is
resolved exclusively from the server-side authorization set established
by OTP and any required secondary factor. Old access and refresh tokens
are invalidated before the replacement pair is returned.

get.description: Return one explicit, permission-minimized operational passenger profile.
Return a bounded, assignment-scoped roster without document bytes.
Stream one assigned passenger document without creating an offline grant.
Top-level alias retained independently of the authentication namespace.

post.description:
Acknowledge a durable, fully refreshed local sync snapshot.

The acknowledgement is deliberately not a sync mutation and therefore
never appends to the change journal.  It is accepted only for the live
access generation, a non-future journal cursor, and the exact current
resource revisions the client says it committed locally.

get.description:
Return a metadata-only fence for an atomic client-side full rebase.

The journal watermark is intentionally captured before the resource
revisions. If a dashboard transaction commits between those reads, the
returned cursor can lag the returned versions, but it can never skip that
transaction: its journal entry remains available on the next delta pass.
Clients stage the paginated resources, atomically promote them with this
baseline cursor, and use ``/sync/ack`` as the final revision check.
Return only explicitly granted, currently available groups.
Return only passenger-owned metadata; never return storage locations.
